description: §19.16.3 rule 1 carve-outs — a `break`/`continue` whose target loop is INSIDE the deferred body is legal, and a function nested inside the deferred body is its own control-flow scope (its `return` is legal). No E-DEFER-* fires; at exit the deferred body runs: trace = "body;x1;pos;".
rationale: §19.16.3 rule 1: only a `break`/`continue` whose target lies OUTSIDE the deferred body is restricted; a nested function or lambda body's own `return` is not restricted.
